name: 27527 · Clayton, NC
findings: ZIP 27527 (Clayton) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27527 (Clayton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27527 (Clayton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).
